comments.author: BLiPGames
comments.body: If you're *really* new to the whole process, search Reddit for the name Karpathy. It's a reference to Andrej Karpathy, the co-founder of OpenAI. He put out a "4 rules to vibecoding" post and it's got a lot of discussion on Reddit with people adding to and modifying it. Even if you don't find everything you want to know, it will give you an idea of where to look.

comments.author: teamharder
comments.body: There's free assets on Itch.io. All three of the big game engines are free until you make big money. Godot, Unity, and Unreal. All of the them have MCP for your chosen model to interact with. I use Unity. Here's the git url for the MCP. https://github.com/CoplayDev/unity-mcp. You go to Package Manager> add via git url> paste url> start server. Start up Codex, Claude Code, or Open Code. Tell em to look for the MCP server. Should be it.
